en: John 9

p.src: 1  As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

en: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
u.src: 1  As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

p.src: 2  His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

en: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
u.src: 2  His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

p.src: 3  Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

en: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.
u.src: 3  Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

p.src: 4  I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

en: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
u.src: 4  I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

p.src: 5  While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

en: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
u.src: 5  While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

p.src: 6  When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

p.src: 7  and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

en: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.
u.src: 7  and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

p.src: 8  Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

en: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”
u.src: 8  Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

p.src: 9  Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

en: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

en: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”
u.src: 10  They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

p.src: 11  He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

en: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

p.src: 12  Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

en: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
u.src: 12  Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

p.src: 13  They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

en: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.
u.src: 13  They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

p.src: 14  It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

en: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
u.src: 14  It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

p.src: 15  Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

en: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

p.src: 16  Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

en: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

p.src: 17  Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

en: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
u.src: 17  Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

p.src: 18  The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

en: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

p.src: 19  and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

en: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

p.src: 21  but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

p.src: 22  His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

p.src: 23  Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

p.src: 24  So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

en: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

p.src: 25  He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

en: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

p.src: 26  They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

en: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
u.src: 26  They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

p.src: 27  He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

en: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

p.src: 28  They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

en: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

p.src: 29  We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

p.src: 30  The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

en: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

p.src: 31  We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.

en: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.
